# discord_server_template (List Resource)

Lists the templates of a server. Requires the Manage Server permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "discord_server_template" "all" {
  provider         = discord
  include_resource = true

  config {
    server_id = var.server_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild) to list templates of.
